faqs.question: What is the best khaprail tile in Lahore?
faqs.answer: The best khaprail tile is evenly fired, rings clearly when tapped, has consistent sizing and a profile that suits your roof pitch. Judge it by handling a sample, not by a photo. Pak Clay offers free samples in Lahore.

faqs.question: Are khaprail tiles good for Lahore's monsoon?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the tile is well fired and correctly laid with enough overlap and pitch. Most leaks come from laying or drainage details rather than the clay itself, so plan the roof design with your contractor.

faqs.question: How much do khaprail tiles cost in Lahore?
faqs.answer: The rate depends on profile, finish, quantity and delivery, so we give a written, dated quote for your roof instead of a fixed web price. Send your area and profile on WhatsApp to get one.

faqs.question: Khaprail tiles or concrete roof tiles: which is better?
faqs.answer: Clay is usually chosen for its long life, colour that does not need repainting and thermal comfort, while concrete can cost less at first. Decide on your budget, how long you will own the property and the look you want.
